critical_code_review_comments: upgradeNudge.js: NUDGE_COPY centralization is clean; DEFAULT_COPY fallback prevents crashes on unknown featureId — good defensive design. trackNudge wrapped in try/catch so analytics never breaks UI.

EntitlementToast.jsx: sessionStorage dedup key `pm_ent_toast_${feature}` with 3s window is per-feature (not global), so different features can still stack — verified in test (DT + HH toasts coexist). Correct UX.
auth.js:11-27 axios interceptor: reads both detail.feature and detail.required_feature — flexible against backend contract variations. Non-fatal on missing feature (silent no-op).

LockedFeature.jsx:36-40 fires 'view' event via useEffect with hasFeature dep — potential extra fires if hasFeature identity changes on each render (not memoized in useEntitlements). Minor: could result in duplicate view events per session. Non-blocking.

HouseHealthCard.jsx HouseHealthNudge uses window.location.href for navigation instead of useNavigate — this causes a full page reload to /pricing (SPA loses state). Recommend using useNavigate for consistency with other nudges (LockedFeature.jsx:53 uses navigate correctly). Minor UX issue.
EntitlementToast: no cleanup of sessionStorage keys on logout/user switch — a user who logs out and logs in as different tier could see suppressed toasts for 3s. Very minor.
Axios interceptor is registered as a module side-effect at import time (auth.js:11) — will only run once per bundle, safe. No leak risk.
